npc.runecraftory.florist.1.dating_accept: Wait... really?! Oh my goodness! That's wonderful! I was already having such a lovely time whenever we were together, but now... well, I'm practically bouncing! Yes, of course!
You like me? Aww! That's so sweet! I think I've been feeling the same way for a while now. I just never really stopped to think about it. I'd love to be with you!
Oh, %player%! You've made me so happy! I can't promise I'll ever sit still for very long, but I can promise you'll never have a dull moment with me. Yes!
npc.runecraftory.florist.1.dating_deny.1: Oh! That's so sweet of you! I'm really happy you feel comfortable telling me, but I think I like us better as friends. I hope that's okay!
npc.runecraftory.florist.1.dating_deny.2: Aww, you're wonderful! But I don't think I feel that kind of spark. I still think you're a lovely person, though!
npc.runecraftory.florist.1.dating_deny.3: Oh goodness, I wasn't expecting that! I'm flattered, truly, but my heart doesn't quite feel the same way. I hope we can still be friends!
Oh, for me? How sweet! Thank you so much! It's always lovely to receive a little surprise!
npc.runecraftory.florist.1.dislike.1:
Oh, thank you! 
It's not quite my kind of thing. Things I like? I like %like%.
npc.runecraftory.florist.1.divorce.1: Oh... I see. That's really sad, isn't it? I always thought we'd have so many more happy days together. But I won't force you to stay. I hope life brings you plenty of beautiful things.
npc.runecraftory.florist.1.divorce.2: So... we're going our separate ways? I guess even the prettiest flowers eventually lose their petals. I'll always remember the good times, though.
npc.runecraftory.florist.1.divorce.3: Oh, %player%... I wish things had turned out differently. But I don't want us to stay together just because we're afraid of change. Please take care of yourself!
npc.runecraftory.florist.1.divorce_error: Divorce?! But... wait, when did we get married? Did I miss a whole wedding while I was out picking flowers?
Oh! I think you've gotten a little ahead of yourself. We aren't married yet, silly!
Huh? Divorce? But we haven't even had a wedding! You're moving faster than a bee chasing spring flowers!
npc.runecraftory.florist.1.first.1:
Oh, hello there! Welcome! 
I'm %npc%, the local florist. 
I grow and arrange all sorts of flowers. You should stop by sometime! There's always something blooming, and I promise the place smells much nicer than most shops around here!
npc.runecraftory.florist.1.first.2:
Well, hello, hello! Haven't seen you around before! 
I'm %npc%, and I take care of the little flower shop nearby. If you like flowers, you're going to love it there. If you don't... well, I might just change your mind!
npc.runecraftory.florist.1.first.3:
Oh! A new face! How exciting! I'm %npc%. 
I spend most of my days surrounded by flowers, which is probably why I'm always in such a good mood. Well, that and the occasional cake.
npc.runecraftory.florist.1.first.4:
Hi there! 
I'm %npc%, the person responsible for making this place a little more colorful. 
Flowers, plants, little decorations... I love it all! You should come visit sometime!
npc.runecraftory.florist.1.follow_no.1: Aww, not today? That's alright! I've got plenty of little things to do around here anyway.
npc.runecraftory.florist.1.follow_no.2: Oh, I'd love to, but I promised myself I'd finish a few things first. Maybe next time!
npc.runecraftory.florist.1.follow_no.3: Mmm, I think I'll stay here for now. There's a little patch of flowers I've been meaning to take care of!
npc.runecraftory.florist.1.follow_stop.1: Already going back? Oh well! That was fun! Let's do it again sometime!
npc.runecraftory.florist.1.follow_stop.2: Hehe, I think I could wander around all day. But I suppose I should take care of my flowers, too!
npc.runecraftory.florist.1.follow_stop.3: Thanks for taking me along! I had a lovely time. Don't forget to enjoy the sunshine while you're out there!
npc.runecraftory.florist.1.follow_talk.1: Isn't it lovely out here? I could spend the entire day wandering around. Actually, I probably will!
npc.runecraftory.florist.1.follow_talk.2: Oh, look at that! Did you see it? There's always something interesting hiding somewhere.
npc.runecraftory.florist.1.follow_talk.3: Let's keep moving! There's so much to see, and I don't want to miss anything!
npc.runecraftory.florist.1.follow_yes.1: An adventure?! Oh, absolutely! Let me grab a few things. You never know when we might find something beautiful along the way!
npc.runecraftory.florist.1.follow_yes.2: Yay! I was hoping you'd ask! Let's go somewhere exciting. Somewhere with lots of sunshine, preferably!
npc.runecraftory.florist.1.follow_yes.3: Of course! I could use a change of scenery. Besides, staying in one place for too long makes my feet itchy!
npc.runecraftory.florist.1.greeting.1:
Oh, %player%! There you are! 
I was just about to go for a walk. Perfect timing! How have you been?
npc.runecraftory.florist.1.greeting.2:
Hiii! It's so nice to see you! 
Have you been outside today? The weather is lovely, and the flowers are absolutely glowing!
npc.runecraftory.florist.1.greeting.3:
Oh, hello again! I've got about a hundred things I want to do today. 
Hmm... maybe a hundred and one now that you're here!
npc.runecraftory.florist.1.greeting.4:
There you are! I was wondering when I'd see you again. 
Come on, tell me something interesting! I love hearing about your adventures.
npc.runecraftory.florist.1.hate.1:
Oh... um, that's certainly not something I'd ever want. 

I suppose not every little surprise can be a happy one.
npc.runecraftory.florist.1.like.1:
Ohhh, I love it! It's absolutely wonderful! 
Thank you, %player%! You've made me so happy!
npc.runecraftory.florist.1.marriage_acce: MARRIAGE?! Oh my goodness, yes! Just imagine all the flowers, the sunshine, and all the wonderful days we'll share! I can't think of anything better than spending my life with you!
You want to marry me? Really?! Oh, I'm so happy! I already love spending every day with you, and I can't wait to make a million more memories together. Yes, yes, YES!
Oh, this is the most wonderful surprise! I don't need a fancy castle or a grand life. Just a little home, a garden full of flowers, and you. That's my dream. I accept!
npc.runecraftory.florist.1.marriage_deny: Oh! That's such a lovely thought! But marriage is a really big step, and I think I need a little more time before I'm ready for it. I hope you understand!
You're making me blush! I care about you so much, but I don't want to rush into something this important. Let's enjoy what we have for now!
Aww, %player%... I'd love to say yes someday, but I still have a few things I want to figure out first. Please don't be sad!
npc.runecraftory.florist.1.procreation_c: Hehe, eager, aren't we? Let's enjoy a little time together first! There's no need to rush through all the lovely moments.
Oh, not just yet! How about we go outside, enjoy the sunshine, and spend some time together?
Mmm, I think we could use a little break. There are so many other fun things we could do together!
npc.runecraftory.florist.1.talk.1: I think flowers are a little like people. They all have their own personalities, you know? Some are bright and cheerful, others are quiet and delicate. I like finding the perfect place for each one.
npc.runecraftory.florist.1.talk.2: Sometimes I just wander around without any particular destination. You'd be surprised how many wonderful things you find when you're not looking for anything specific!
npc.runecraftory.florist.1.talk.3: I planted some wildflowers near the river yesterday. They're not particularly rare or valuable, but seeing them sway in the breeze makes me smile. That's reason enough, isn't it?
npc.runecraftory.florist.1.talk.4: Oh, I really want to visit the flower fields beyond the hills someday! I've heard there are flowers there that only bloom once every few years. Imagine seeing something like that!
